snippet.title: DCS: C-130J
snippet.description:
We are delighted to announce that DCS: C-130J is now available. Developed by Airplane Simulation Company, it brings one of the world’s widely used tactical air lifters into DCS as a fully fledged, deeply simulated module. 

DCS e-shop: https://www.digitalcombatsimulator.com/en/shop/modules/c-130j/
DCS on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3899930/DCS_C130J/
